# CLAUDE.md

Guidance for Claude Code (and other AI agents) working in this repository.

## Project Overview

**Escola** is a Sistema de Gestão Escolar (School Management System) with a Django REST
Framework backend and a React + TypeScript frontend, containerized with Docker.

## AI Team Configuration (autogenerated by team-configurator, 2026-08-27)

**Important: YOU MUST USE subagents when available for the task.**

### Detected Stack

- **Backend framework:** Django 6.1 + Django REST Framework 3.18 (Python >= 3.13)
- **API tooling:** drf-spectacular (OpenAPI schema), djangorestframework-simplejwt (JWT auth),
  django-filter, django-cors-headers
- **Database:** PostgreSQL 16 (via `psycopg[binary]` 3.3.4)
- **Cache / broker:** Redis 8 (django-redis, Celery 5.6 for async/background tasks)
- **Backend testing:** pytest + pytest-django, factory-boy, faker, coverage
- **Backend tooling:** black, ruff, mypy (+ django-stubs / drf-stubs), gunicorn, whitenoise,
  boto3 / django-storages (S3), Dockerized (backend/Dockerfile)
- **Frontend framework:** React 18 + TypeScript, built with Vite
- **Frontend state/data:** TanStack Query (server state), Zustand (client state),
  React Hook Form + Zod (forms/validation), Axios, React Router 6
- **Frontend styling:** Tailwind CSS 3 (class-variance-authority, tailwind-merge, lucide-react icons)
- **Frontend testing:** Vitest + Testing Library (unit), Playwright (e2e)
- **CI/CD:** GitHub Actions (`backend-ci.yml`, `frontend-ci.yml`, `main.yml`), with
  Postgres 16 and Redis 7 service containers
- **Recent context:** Django/dependency major-version upgrade just landed; recent frontend
  work added the Documentos (CRUD) menu and a Configurações page (profile, notifications,
  appearance, security)

### Agent Assignments

| Task | Agent | Notes |
|------|-------|-------|
| Django models, views, services, business logic | `django-backend-expert` | Primary backend agent; project-aware, follows existing app structure under `backend/apps/*` |
| DRF serializers, viewsets, routers, JWT/permissions, drf-spectacular schemas | `django-api-developer` | For REST API endpoints (e.g. Documentos, Configurações backend support) |
| ORM query optimization, migrations, indexing, N+1 fixes | `django-orm-expert` | Especially relevant post-upgrade (Django 6.1) and for reporting/dashboard apps |
| React components, hooks, page composition | `react-component-architect` | For `frontend/src/pages`, `components`, e.g. Documentos CRUD, Configurações tabs |
| Tailwind styling / design-system consistency | `tailwind-frontend-expert` | Utility-first CSS work across the React app |
| General/full-stack API contract design | `api-architect` | When designing new endpoints spanning both frontend and backend conventions |
| Cross-cutting code quality review | `code-reviewer` | Use after any non-trivial change, especially post-upgrade diffs |
| Performance profiling & optimization | `performance-optimizer` | DB queries, Celery tasks, React re-renders, bundle size |
| Docker / GitHub Actions / deployment pipeline | `Python DevOps/CI-CD Expert` | `docker-compose.yml`, `backend/Dockerfile`, `frontend/Dockerfile`, `.github/workflows/*` |
| pytest/pytest-django test design & coverage | `Python Testing Expert` | Backend test suite in `backend/tests/` |
| Security review (JWT, CORS, secrets, deps) | `Python Security Expert` | Relevant given the recent Django/library version bump |
| Full-stack architecture / multi-domain planning | `tech-lead-orchestrator` | For large features touching backend + frontend + infra together |
| Initial deep-dive / onboarding into unfamiliar code areas | `code-archaeologist` | Use before large refactors |

### Sample Commands

- "@django-backend-expert review the recent Django 6.1 upgrade for breaking changes in `backend/apps/`"
- "@django-api-developer build a Documentos API endpoint with filtering and pagination"
- "@react-component-architect implement the Configurações security tab in `frontend/src/pages`"
- "@code-reviewer review the diff from the Django upgrade commit"
- "@Python Testing Expert add pytest-django coverage for the documents app"
